G2 WHAT THIS SCREEN CAN AND CANNOT SEE
for scale, the effects this arc has measured: geometry +0.0058, four blocks +0.0123
8M -> 35M was +0.0181 for 4.4x the parameters; 650M is 18.6x the parameters again
G3 650M minus 35M, as a sequence arm alone: -0.0169 sem 0.0064 = -2.7 sem

this screen did not see a gain of 0.0191 or more. That is NOT evidence that 650M is no better -- the measured difference is -0.0169 and anything below 0.0191 is invisible at n=471. What it rules out is a LARGE gain, and a large gain was the hypothesis worth screening cheaply.
G4 inside loop 163d's four-block merge at frozen weights (0.1, 0.1, 0.1):
the screen did not see a gain inside the merge either, at this resolution.
G5 ARE THE TWO ENCODERS EVEN DIFFERENT?
per-case oracle over the pair 0.7089, i.e. +0.0256 over 35M (+7.3 sem)
the encoders disagree case by case at rho +0.7056, so there is something a larger model could be reading differently even if the mean gain is small.
n=471 cannot resolve an effect below 0.0191.
Fewer training proteins per fold degrades k-NN for EVERY arm, so the absolute numbers
here sit below the 2,178-protein run and only the PAIRED differences are comparable.
A screen that fails to see an effect has not shown that there is none.
